subject: general
question: Who among the following was a popular name of the 14th century Persian literature, associated with ghazals and was loved for his perfect personality and art of poetry?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Hafez.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Khwaja Shams-ud-Din Muhammed Hafez-e-Shiraz**

 
 
• **Hafez **is a sufi muslim who was born, raised, and passed away in **Shiraz **in the 14th century when the Ilkhanate ruled Iran.
 
• He is regarded as one of **Persians' favourite poets**.
 
• People called him **Hafez**, which means **memorizer**, because he had memorised the Quran at a young age.
 
• Hafez disgraces **religious hypocrisy **and infuses his poetry, particularly his **ghazals**, or sonnets, with the **essence of love and joy. **He also offers advice on how to live a better life.
 
• In Iran, **October 12** is annually celebrated as **Hafez Day** to remember him.
 
• The most famous work by Hafez is the **Divan of Hafez.**
 
• It is a collection of his remaining poetry that was probably put together after his death is a beautiful example of Persian literature, and it can be found in the **homes of Persian speakers all over the world**. Iranians think that the Quran and the Divan-e-Hafez should be in each and every Iranian home. 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• One of Shiraz's cultural landmarks, the **Tomb of Hafez** is popular and admired by Iranians and visitors alike. 
 
• His writings, which is translated by **William Jones** translate into English in 1771, had a strong impact on Western thinkers and writers like **Goethe and Ralph Waldo Emerson**.
 
• Emerson praised Hafez by saying, **"Hafez is the poet for poets."**
 
• **Fal-e-Hafez **(reading Hafez) is an another ancient tradition of Persian speakers.
